fixed.summary: Where water meets the ground or a stone it fades into what lies behind over a pixel and a half, its tint and refraction growing from none at the contact: the line was a hard, stair-stepped cut, the thinnest film darkened to the full shallow colour and the stone's foot drawn shifted from the stone above it.

On flowing water the contact foam piles only where the current runs into a bank or stone (its upstream faces), and on any water it fades where the band is narrower than a few pixels: it drew a white rim round every stone and along each bank's whole length.

A fall's sheet thins at its sides into strands with what lies behind showing between them, more broken the further down: it was opaque to the ribbon's straight sides, a board with two vertical cuts hung in front of the rock.
